repos_data.description: AI-powered music production and post-production in REAPER via MCP — 181 tools for composition, mixing, mastering, batch editing, audio QC, and ReaScript automation.
Model Context Protocol server that enables AI assistants to control REAPER for mixing, mastering, MIDI composition and music production.

Free, open source REAPER MCP server that lets an AI agent (Claude or any MCP client) drive REAPER: read every plugin and parameter, set FX values, write automation, and measure a mix move before and after. MIT. macOS, Windows, Linux.
